policy: Every fact names a tier (installed = read from the installed game or tool; primary = upstream source or official API; secondary = community documentation; unverified = not yet checked), a source and the command that re-reads it. Forge enforces only installed and primary facts.

facts.claim: Skyrim PEX files are big-endian, game id 1, format version 3.2 (a few old files are 3.1).
facts.source: 12,223 loose .pex in the game Data parsed by Forge (2026-11-15); UESP Compiled Script File Format

facts.claim: Skyrim SE/AE archives are BSA version 105 with LZ4 frames for compressed entries; LE uses version 104 with zlib. Folder record offsets add the total file-name length.
facts.source: 508/508 archives in the game Data re-serialized byte-identical by Forge; 509 files decoded equal to BSArch 0.9e output

facts.claim: Archive folder and file hashes use the Oblivion/Skyrim scheme (last chars, length, first char, extension bits; 0x1003F rolling hash of the middle and the extension).
facts.source: 83,061 folder and file hashes recomputed from names in 40 installed archives, 0 mismatches

facts.claim: Skyrim SE meshes are NIF 20.2.0.7, user version 12, BS version 100 (LE: 83); block sizes sum to the footer.
facts.source: 1,572 meshes sampled from Skyrim - Meshes0.bsa parsed with consistent block sizes; niftools nif.xml

facts.claim: CreationKit.exe (file version 1.7.99 on the reference install) accepts -OptimizeMasterFile, -BuildShaderList, -ExportDialogue, -GenerateLips, -GenerateSingleLip, -ExportFaceGenData, -TagifyMasterfile, -TagifyPlugin, -ExportText, -CompileTextExport, -DelocalizeMasterfile, -DelocalizeLocalMasterfile, -DumpNeededFiles, -OptimizeDLC, -GenerateSEQ, -ConvertToESL. There is no LOD switch.
facts.source: string table of the installed CreationKit.exe

facts.source: usage text of the installed LipGenerator.exe

facts.claim: FUZ = "FUZE", u32 version 1, u32 LIP size, LIP bytes, then the XWM (RIFF) audio.
Caprica 0.3.0 compiles Skyrim scripts with -g skyrim (Skyrim compatibility options default on).

The official compiler prints <file>.psc(<line>,<col>): <message> with 0-based columns; Caprica prints <file>.psc (<line>, <col>): Error: <message> with 1-based columns. One planted call to an undefined function gives exactly one line from each.
facts.source: planted-error compiles with both installed compilers (2026-11-15)

facts.claim: Spriggit serializes Skyrim SE plugins with the Spriggit.Yaml.Skyrim NuGet package and -g SkyrimSE.
The records worker pins Mutagen.Bethesda.Skyrim 0.54.4, the version houseCARL 2.1.1 ships.
Light plugins with header 1.71 may use new local IDs 0x001-0xFFF (Skyrim.esm must then be the first master when any ID is below 0x800); header 1.70 allows 0x800-0xFFF.
facts.source: community ESL documentation; Skyrim pack instructions
